mapper.select: SELECT e.*, v.license_plate AS vehicle_plate FROM sys_vehicle_expense e LEFT JOIN sys_vehicle v ON v.vehicle_id = e.vehicle_id WHERE e.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} ORDER BY e.expense_date DESC, e.expense_id DESC LIMIT ${limit}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM sys_vehicle_expense WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND expense_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL ${days} DAY)
